answer: The vine lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ivory is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. What survives to the summit is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
